title: Zero-shot rib design: merging training-free generative prior with topology optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.10643v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural load-bearing patterns such as leaf venation, trabecular bone, and spider webs achieve high stiffness per unit mass, yet classical topology optimizers rarely reach such geometries, and few let engineers express structural design intent through natural language. This work treats a frozen text-to-image diffusion model as a training-free source of design knowledge and distills it into the physics loop of density-based topology optimization via score distillation sampling, so that a text prompt becomes an explicit, machine-interpretable representation of engineer intent. The prompt-induced generative gradient and the finite element sensitivity are combined at every iteration, letting physics decide which prompt-induced features survive. translated_title: 零样本加强筋设计：将免训练生成先验与拓扑优化相融合
translated_abstract: 自然界中的承重结构模式（如叶脉、骨小梁和蜘蛛网）能够实现单位质量下的高刚度，然而经典的拓扑优化器很少能达到这样的几何形态，且很少有方法能让工程师通过自然语言表达结构设计意图。本工作将冻结的文本到图像扩散模型视为无需训练的设计知识来源，并通过分数蒸馏采样将其提炼到基于密度的拓扑优化的物理循环中，从而使文本提示成为工程师意图的显式、机器可解释的表达形式。提示诱导的生成梯度与有限元灵敏度在每次迭代中相结合，让物理规律决定哪些由提示诱导的特征得以保留。在涵盖四个几何领域和两种物理模式的245次主要SDS运行中，49个提示-领域组合中有38个实现了统计上显著的柔度降低（最高降低31.5%的机械柔度）。
tldr: 该论文提出将冻结的文本生成图像扩散模型作为免训练的设计知识来源，通过分数蒸馏采样融入拓扑优化迭代过程，使工程师能够用自然语言直接表达结构设计意图，并在49个组合中38个实现了统计显著的柔度降低（最高达31.5%）。
en_tdlr: This paper merges a frozen text-to-image diffusion model as a training-free source of design knowledge into density-based topology optimization via score distillation sampling, enabling engineers to express structural design intent through natural language prompts while achieving statistically significant compliance reductions in 38 of 49 prompt-domain combinations (up to -31.5%).
